newsitem.title: USA: D&K Wholesale says gets $300,000 from PBI.
newsitem.headline: D&K Wholesale says gets $300,000 from PBI.

text.p: D&K Wholesale Drug Inc said it received a dividend distribution of $300,000 from Pharmaceutical Buyers Inc, a privately held Colorado company in which D&K owns a 50-percent interest.

"The dividend distribution, which D&K expects to occur annually (subject to PBI's future performance and cash needs), will not impact the regular quarterly recognition of D&K's equity interest in PBI's earnings on D&K's statement of operations," said the wholesale drugs distributor.
In addition, D&K said its operations are continuing unaffected by heavy flooding in the Ohio River Valley. The company has facilities in Lexington, Ky., Cape Girardeau, Mo., and Minneapolis.
